arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Eldritch at the Tree of Whispers.

{c_important}Eldritch{/c} Effects apply {c_important}Vulnerable{/c} to enemies for {c_random}[{SF_3}|1|]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_2} In addition, damage from {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth and Decay{/c} Effects also apply {c_important}Vulnerable{/c} for half this duration.{/if}
Damage from {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} Effects will also apply Vulnerable at half the duration.
